claim_boundary: Opened-source custom Deform360 calibration study only. This is not official Deform360 benchmark parity, a point-accuracy SOTA claim, or confirmation on any target cohort.

source_amendments.reason: The raw robot carrier was CI-private; consume the already sealed 76-frame known-action carrier and omit five unscored tail frames.

The sealed known-action carrier was also CI-private. The registered scoring reconstruction therefore consumes only scoring-panel RGB, calibration, and source-fitted SAM2 masks. Deform360 depth reconstruction supports an absent robot carrier; the URDF gripper-mask stage is omitted and gripper pixels are not explicitly excluded.

source_amendments.failure_stage: Splatfacto initialization after source suffix decode and SAM2 mask generation, before a reconstructed endpoint or source metric existed
source_amendments.reason: The inherited Python 3.12 environment provided a source-only gsplat package without its CUDA backend. Recreate and fail-closed verify the already validated Deform360 Python 3.10, Torch 2.4 CUDA 12.1, precompiled gsplat, and Nerfstudio runtime before any source suffix decode.

source_amendments.failure_stage: SAM2 mask generation before Splatfacto or source metric evaluation
source_amendments.reason: The pinned runtime passed before suffix decode but fewer than three camera masks succeeded. Per-camera exceptions were caught during generation yet omitted from the retained top-level failure artifact. Preserve the frozen mask threshold and add only failure-stage, camera-record, and successful-mask-count diagnostics.

source_amendments.failure_stage: SAM2 video loading before mask inference, Splatfacto, or source metric evaluation
source_amendments.reason: All twelve registered scoring cameras retained the same ModuleNotFoundError for decord. Add the exact decord 0.6.0 video-decoder dependency used by the existing successful SAM2 environment and bind it into the fail-closed runtime identity.

mean.identity_requirement: candidate and comparator use the exact registered float32 C-order bytes and SHA-256

covariance.comparison: leave-one-case-out isotropic Gaussian plus radial split-conformal sphere
